messages:
Mira P.: Heads up — during yesterday's smoke we saw several noisy tenants trigger per-tenant SLO alerts even though traffic was within configured quota. Thinking we should add a short spillover grace window + routing fallback to Dedicated (or a lower-cost pool) before firing a page. Thoughts?

Ajay S.: +1. Prefer 'soft' thresholds surfaced in the console (no page) and a 5m spillover quiet window. If violations persist after the window, escalate to hard alerts.

Sam L.: I like soft alerts in-console + telemetry first. Also we should sample the signal to avoid noise storms from noisy clients. Paging only on sustained hard breaches.

Jordan K.: Agree with soft first. Question: routing fallback to Dedicated might mask tenant problems if Dedicated gets saturated. Maybe fallback should be non-blocking degraded mode (tail-latency shed) + notify the tenant in-console.

Mira P.: Good call. Proposal — policy schema example: 
```json
{
  "policy_id": "spillover_v1",
  "soft_threshold": { "percent": 90, "window_mins": 5 },
  "hard_threshold": { "percent": 99, "window_mins": 15 },
  "spillover": { "enabled": true, "target_pool": "dedicated_preemptible", "grace_period_secs": 300 },
  "routing_action": "degrade_then_route",
  "telemetry": ["policy_id","evaluated_threshold","routed_pool","decision_reason","sample_rate"]
}
```
Use `soft_threshold` to show incidents in console (yellow state) and `hard_threshold` to page (red).

Ajay S.: For the API contract: alerting evaluation endpoint should return 202 with `policy_applied: true|false` and include `decision_reason` and `routed_pool` when applicable. That lets downstream tooling show accurate console state. Any objections? @Jordan K.

Sam L.: Also we should emit `sampling_rate` and the raw `evaluation_metric` so the console can render a sparkline without calling metrics api.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Policy service rollout started: 1/3 shards. Feature flag `slo_spillover_enabled` toggled for canary.

Jordan K.: Rollout plan idea: 10% small tenants -> monitor false positive rate + paging churn -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. Add a canary dashboard tile showing (a) soft alerts count, (b) routed_pool utilization, (c) hard pages triggered.

Mira P.: I'll draft the rollout checklist and the console tile requirements. @Ajay S. can you add the API contract to the swagger and include example responses?

Ajay S.: On it. Will create a PR today with the contract + example payloads.

Sam L.: :thumbsup: Also please add a synthetic test that triggers a soft threshold and ensures no page is created; good safety net for rollouts.

Mira P.: PR posted: https://git.internal/r/redwood/policy-service/pull/412 — includes schema and example dashboard queries.
